historical_reviews.v3_1: Removal of an entire supply exercises mechanical presence, AC input loss and DC redundancy simultaneously. Evidence must bind the chosen serial/slot/feed to the deasserted presence/input/output state, show that surviving supplies stay within approved load, and demonstrate the same module's stable re-enumeration and LED recovery.

original_test_intent: Verify that every approved single PSU-plus-cord assembly can be removed and reinstalled while the SUT remains continuously powered, with correct PSU-specific SEL and LED recovery.
original_method: Establish a serial/slot/feed map and measured survivor-capacity margin, capture continuous host/BMC and per-PSU telemetry, have an authorized operator remove exactly one hot-plug-approved module with its cord as a controlled assembly, observe continuity and slot-specific events, reinstall the same assembly, wait for current sharing and LED stabilization, then gate the next slot on complete recovery.
manual_activity: A power owner verifies N-1 capacity and hot-plug support; an authorized AC/ESD operator removes and reinstalls each mapped assembly while an observer records the local LED and continuity.
required_inputs: Measured system load and N-1 capacity limit
safety_requirements: Verify N-1 capacity before every removal
Handle modules and AC cords only by an authorized operator
Do not disturb neighboring feeds or supplies
Monitor surviving PSU current, temperature and alarms continuously
Stop on any host/BMC outage or overload indication
Do not retry an abnormal slot
Do not proceed until the reinstalled module shares load normally
agent_execution_scope: Validate approved identity, topology and load margin
Collect full pre-removal PSU and system state
Continuously timestamp host/BMC reachability and survivor telemetry
Correlate presence/input/output and SEL changes to the selected slot
Verify re-enumeration, load sharing and stable recovery after reinsertion
Archive evidence without touching hardware or setting verdict
engineer_actions: Approve hot-plug support, N-1 margin and slot order
Supervise safe module-plus-cord removal and reinsertion
Stop after any outage, overload or abnormal connector behavior
Provide spare/recovery intervention if the supply does not return

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The grep/tail suggestions can miss slot identity, older SEL entries and short continuity loss; they neither establish N-1 headroom nor prove current sharing after reinsertion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Continuously collect the complete PSU inventory, input/output/presence/current/temperature state, untruncated SEL and host/BMC reachability while the operator performs the approved one-assembly cycle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Every installed PSU-plus-cord assembly and the 5-minute source estimate remain in scope, with each next iteration conditional on stable recovery.

modernized_recommendation.status: SERIALIZED N-1 PSU ASSEMBLY HOT-PLUG WITH LOAD-SHARING PROOF
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure load margin, bind the physical assembly to slot and feeds, record continuous service plus slot-specific removal events, then require correct reinsertion, LED state and recovered current sharing before another slot.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds capacity proof, assembly identity, continuous outage detection and quantitative reintegration evidence to the source's per-PSU physical sequence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A chassis that appears powered on at the end may still have suffered a brief reset, overloaded surviving supplies or failed to return the reinserted unit to current sharing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Energized module and cord handling can arc, disturb adjacent supplies or exhaust N-1 capacity; physical seating and LED state remain outside Agent observation.

SUT/BMC/firmware identity, operator/observer and synchronized timeline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require one PSU-plus-cord assembly at a time, continuous SUT power, expected SEL and LED recovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation and acceptance are clear. Missing platform-specific hot-plug, capacity and operator inputs are execution prerequisites, so the review is REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Makes continuous power, remaining-supply headroom and post-insertion current sharing independently measurable instead of relying on a final sensor snapshot.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PSU module removal changes more than AC-present state: it removes a DC converter and forces an immediate load transfer. A valid result therefore needs high-cadence continuity observation and surviving-supply current evidence during the transient, followed by proof that the reinstalled serial returned to the intended slot and accepted load. Without those checks, a fast reboot or a supply that remains idle can be mistaken for successful hot-plug behavior.
